title: Template: Next.js Browser Runtime Regression Debugging
goal: Investigate and fix a real Next.js storefront runtime regression by using browser evidence to stabilize a cold-start hydration path, defer advanced compare code out of the initial chunk set, and stop repeated interactions from accumulating runtime handlers while preserving the real downstream catalog inputs.
skillBenefitRationale: The debugging category benefits directly because the task forces a realistic browser-first incident workflow: triage symptoms from incident evidence, reproduce them in a live browser, measure visual stability and code-loading behavior, implement a root-cause fix, and defend against shortcuts that bypass the real runtime bottlenecks.
